geometry_checks.scope: Production shared hurtbox and area geometry primitives; session wiring verified separately by source inspection and normal sessions.

marker_deadline_review.scope: Rechecks conservative initial-tell zeros using each marker's own release deadline and production hurt4 geometry. Tests marker series only; active hazards/projectiles are not replayed. Full damage-on reactive sessions separately establish actual successful phase completions.

limitations: Fixed artificial fixtures do not establish reachable campaign builds or human difficulty acceptance.
Boss isolated-phase samples do not imply continuous-duel success; continuous-duel B18 center fails.
Boss different-seed repeats at the same fixture are deterministic, not independent difficulty samples.
Exposure resets HP and disables offense; its damage/outcome is not survival evidence.
Initial warning zero-direction counts were conservative; marker timing replay uses each own deadline and excludes simultaneous projectiles/hazards.

CPU Intel Core i5-14600K / Godot4.6.2 headless logic only, excludes rendering/audio/controller. Sampling window coordinated with core; OS not isolated. Largest observed mob tick25.971ms; p95 does not guarantee60FPS.
Total alive is not on-screen count; local pressure metric radius240 and renderer camera measurements should be read separately.
Growth compares actual Boss-appearance checkpoints, not full chapter XP economy.
Original performance/full-suite reports use initial candidate hashes; final B17 regression comprises6 targeted logic samples without renewed whole-suite/FPS claim.

final_delta.behavior_delta: Only B17 human general_cut approach speed210; authored body speed64/charge820/tell1.25 remain. Runtime override applies only while closing to next move range.
final_delta.scope: B17-only final regression; preserves normal resources through both phases. Cadence uses HP reset and offense suppression only to measure complete move timing.
